c: Grand Cross creates a light beam in the middle with wooden crosses that spiral across it in the middle of the screen and damage enemies it contacts.

Grand Cross has a 0.1 second Hitbox Delay, meaning that the same enemy cannot be hit more often than every tenth of a second by the same cross. However, because all active delays are reset simultaneously as soon as any one elapses, some enemies may get hit more often.
